simple.meaning: צְעָדָה (tsᵉʻâdâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a march ; (concretely) an (ornamental) ankle-chain.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צְעָדָה (H6807) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 5:24, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צְעָדָה (H6807) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צְעָדָה (H6807) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צְעָדָה (tsᵉʻâdâh) / H6807 is traced through 2 Samuel 5:24, 1 Chronicles 14:15, Isaiah 3:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
